title: Manual Log Splitter – Wall-Mounted Cast Iron
descriptionHtml:
Stop struggling with the axe – split wood safely and easily

There is something special about heating with your own firewood. But standing there chopping with an axe is heavy, takes time and can be downright dangerous when the axe slips. Plenty of backs and thumbs have paid the price in the woodshed.

A simpler and safer solution

Our manual log splitter in solid cast iron mounts easily on a wall or a stump. You place the wood in the splitting cone and strike it with a mallet – the force is concentrated straight down into the wood instead of into a swinging axe. No cords, no electricity, no hassle. Just pure splitting power when you need it.

Features

  • Made of durable cast iron for many years of use
  • Wall-mounted design – keep your hands away from the blade
  • Needs no electricity or fuel
  • Ergonomic for efficient splitting with less effort
  • Perfect for logs, twigs and sticks for the stove or fireplace

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
